full_page.content:
1943, December 4
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
(First part is a printed card of acknowledgement:) In acknowledgement of your charitable gifts of Five Dollars
for which we are extremely grateful, and for your civic minded interest in the welfare of God's poor.
REV. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
(to the above Fr. Solanus added the following written message:) God bless you Winifred O"Donnell and Joseph too.
Pl. pardon delay in acknowledgement. Hope by this time things have adjusted themselves brigher and better than before.
(on other side of card)
December 4th, 1943
P. S. God bless you Mrs. O"Donnell again. Having written the acknowledgement over several weeks ago without mailing it at once, I just found it snowed under other work.
I hope things have adjusted themselves brighter before this. Brs. Francis and Leo and all send Best Regards. Now that the season for it is fast approaching we wish you all the blessings that go to make a really blessed Christmas and Happy New Year.
Yours Sincerely in the Sacred Heart.
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. C.
